sourceRegistryExternalRefresh.policy: A refreshed observation replaces a legacy value only when the World Bank API returns a numeric observation. When a refresh is unavailable, previously stored World Bank observations are preserved.

dataQualityPolicy.missingValue: null means unknown, unavailable, not imported, or not comparable; never zero.
dataQualityPolicy.profileScope: Source-backed country data is kept separate from modelled game context and project-derived analytics.
dataQualityPolicy.derivedValues: Direct observations keep provider, source identifier, observation year, unit, and source URL. Derived numerical indicators are created only when required inputs are numeric and all required observation years match.
dataQualityPolicy.analyticalScores: Peer-relative project analytics, not official rankings, credit ratings, combat readiness ratings, or country classifications. Each result includes coverage and input-year diagnostics.
dataQualityPolicy.qualitativeClaims: Qualitative strengths, weaknesses, strategic dependencies, and diplomatic reach must be supported by sourced indicators or explicitly tagged as analyst/game-authored. They are never inferred as facts from a missing field.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Reserve military personnel

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Arms transfers exported

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Diplomatic missions abroad

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Foreign diplomatic missions in country

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Active treaty/alliance memberships
extensionMetricDefinitions.sourcePolicy: Official treaty texts and organization membership lists; each entry requires start/end/validity dates.
extensionMetricDefinitions.description: Raw count only; strategic importance varies and must not be assumed equal.

extensionMetricDefinitions.title: Public-debt interest to revenue

peerComparison.rule: Percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year, with at least five country/territory observations in that year cohort.

thresholds.wgiPositiveSignal: value >= +0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale
thresholds.wgiPressureSignal: value <= -0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale
thresholds.highPublicDebtPressure: public debt >= 80% GDP in the recorded observation
thresholds.materialTradeDeficitPressure: trade balance <= -5% GDP in the recorded/derived observation

evidenceClasses.SAME_YEAR_PEER_COMPARISON: Relative comparison among values with exactly the same metric and observation year.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

evidenceClasses.REGISTERED_INDICATOR: Registered source-backed or legacy value; inspect its year and source status.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.

Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.

Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

thresholds.wgiPositiveSignal: value >= +0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale

thresholds.materialTradeDeficitPressure: trade balance <= -5% GDP in the recorded/derived observation

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

peerComparison.rule: Percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year, with at least five country/territory observations in that year cohort.

thresholds.wgiPositiveSignal: value >= +0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale
thresholds.wgiPressureSignal: value <= -0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale
thresholds.highPublicDebtPressure: public debt >= 80% GDP in the recorded observation
thresholds.materialTradeDeficitPressure: trade balance <= -5% GDP in the recorded/derived observation

evidenceClasses.REGISTERED_INDICATOR: Registered source-backed or legacy value; inspect its year and source status.
evidenceClasses.REPOSITORY_DERIVED_INDEX: Project-defined index, not an official rating.
evidenceClasses.SAME_YEAR_PEER_COMPARISON: Relative comparison among values with exactly the same metric and observation year.
evidenceClasses.COUNTRY_SPECIFIC_LEGACY_GAME_PARAMETER: Country-specific OMEGA game parameter, not an observed national statistic.
evidenceClasses.GAMEPLAY_SCENARIO_REGISTRY: Simulated gameplay asset context, not an official real-world resource statistic.
evidenceClasses.DATA_GAP: Required evidence is unavailable; no low/zero value is implied.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

thresholds.wgiPositiveSignal: value >= +0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale
thresholds.wgiPressureSignal: value <= -0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale

thresholds.materialTradeDeficitPressure: trade balance <= -5% GDP in the recorded/derived observation

evidenceClasses.REGISTERED_INDICATOR: Registered source-backed or legacy value; inspect its year and source status.
evidenceClasses.REPOSITORY_DERIVED_INDEX: Project-defined index, not an official rating.
evidenceClasses.SAME_YEAR_PEER_COMPARISON: Relative comparison among values with exactly the same metric and observation year.

evidenceClasses.DATA_GAP: Required evidence is unavailable; no low/zero value is implied.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.

Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

evidenceClasses.REGISTERED_INDICATOR: Registered source-backed or legacy value; inspect its year and source status.
evidenceClasses.REPOSITORY_DERIVED_INDEX: Project-defined index, not an official rating.
evidenceClasses.SAME_YEAR_PEER_COMPARISON: Relative comparison among values with exactly the same metric and observation year.
evidenceClasses.COUNTRY_SPECIFIC_LEGACY_GAME_PARAMETER: Country-specific OMEGA game parameter, not an observed national statistic.
evidenceClasses.GAMEPLAY_SCENARIO_REGISTRY: Simulated gameplay asset context, not an official real-world resource statistic.
evidenceClasses.DATA_GAP: Required evidence is unavailable; no low/zero value is implied.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.

Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.

Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

evidenceClasses.REGISTERED_INDICATOR: Registered source-backed or legacy value; inspect its year and source status.
evidenceClasses.REPOSITORY_DERIVED_INDEX: Project-defined index, not an official rating.
evidenceClasses.SAME_YEAR_PEER_COMPARISON: Relative comparison among values with exactly the same metric and observation year.
evidenceClasses.COUNTRY_SPECIFIC_LEGACY_GAME_PARAMETER: Country-specific OMEGA game parameter, not an observed national statistic.
evidenceClasses.GAMEPLAY_SCENARIO_REGISTRY: Simulated gameplay asset context, not an official real-world resource statistic.
evidenceClasses.DATA_GAP: Required evidence is unavailable; no low/zero value is implied.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

tendencies: Country-specific diplomatic behaviour is not sufficiently measured; treat any strategic direction as a hypothesis to test in play.

strengths: No standout economic advantage can be established from the currently available registered indicators.
vulnerabilities: No major macroeconomic vulnerability crosses the profile thresholds in the currently available fields; missing values are not evidence of safety.
limitations: Fiscal risk, fiscal health and economic influence indexes are not official sovereign ratings.

institutionalPressurePoints.title: Governance pressure signal

limitations: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration.

dependencies.interpretationPolicy: Only country-specific legacy parameters are presented as modelled dependencies; general macro signals are labelled as pressure signals, not proof of dependence on a named state.
measurementGaps: Named import-supplier shares and critical-import concentration are not registered for every country.

overallWeaknesses: Comparable governance evidence is too sparse to rate political stability or institutional strength confidently.
playerAdvantages: Use targeted regional partnerships and verify country data before committing to an expensive national strategy.

peerComparison.rule: Percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year, with at least five country/territory observations in that year cohort.
peerComparison.governanceCompositeRule: The project-derived governance summary is emitted only when all six governance dimensions have available comparable peer percentiles; it is not an official governance rating.
peerComparison.interpretation: No percentile means no comparable cohort was available; it does not mean low strength.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.

The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.

The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

recordedResourceContext.interpretation: Categories present in game context; empty or repeated lists do not prove real-world absence or abundance.

strengths: No standout economic advantage can be established from the currently available registered indicators.
vulnerabilities: No major macroeconomic vulnerability crosses the profile thresholds in the currently available fields; missing values are not evidence of safety.
limitations: Fiscal risk, fiscal health and economic influence indexes are not official sovereign ratings.

A trade deficit alone does not establish dependence on a specific foreign country or commodity.

riskSignals: No usable military-expenditure observation is available in the general registry.

military.caveat: Military spending, economic scale and population are contextual indicators only, not evidence of operational force strength without verified force structure, readiness, equipment, sustainment and logistics data.

risks: Comparable governance evidence is too sparse to rate political stability or institutional strength confidently.

institutionalPressurePoints.title: Governance pressure signal

limitations: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration.

dependencies.interpretationPolicy: Only country-specific legacy parameters are presented as modelled dependencies; general macro signals are labelled as pressure signals, not proof of dependence on a named state.
measurementGaps: Named import-supplier shares and critical-import concentration are not registered for every country.
External debt creditor composition, energy import share and foreign-aid shares need source-backed records before they can be rated as measured dependence.
A model signal can prioritise an in-game investigation but is not a verified real-world dependence statistic.

overallWeaknesses: Comparable governance evidence is too sparse to rate political stability or institutional strength confidently.
playerAdvantages: Use targeted regional partnerships and verify country data before committing to an expensive national strategy.

strategyOptions.title: Improve evidence coverage before expensive commitments

peerComparison.rule: Percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year, with at least five country/territory observations in that year cohort.
peerComparison.governanceCompositeRule: The project-derived governance summary is emitted only when all six governance dimensions have available comparable peer percentiles; it is not an official governance rating.
peerComparison.interpretation: No percentile means no comparable cohort was available; it does not mean low strength.

evidenceClasses.SAME_YEAR_PEER_COMPARISON: Relative comparison among values with exactly the same metric and observation year.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

dependencies.interpretationPolicy: Only country-specific legacy parameters are presented as modelled dependencies; general macro signals are labelled as pressure signals, not proof of dependence on a named state.

peerComparison.rule: Percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year, with at least five country/territory observations in that year cohort.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

strengths: No standout economic advantage can be established from the currently available registered indicators.
vulnerabilities: No major macroeconomic vulnerability crosses the profile thresholds in the currently available fields; missing values are not evidence of safety.
limitations: Fiscal risk, fiscal health and economic influence indexes are not official sovereign ratings.

limitations: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration.

dependencies.interpretationPolicy: Only country-specific legacy parameters are presented as modelled dependencies; general macro signals are labelled as pressure signals, not proof of dependence on a named state.
measurementGaps: Named import-supplier shares and critical-import concentration are not registered for every country.
External debt creditor composition, energy import share and foreign-aid shares need source-backed records before they can be rated as measured dependence.
A model signal can prioritise an in-game investigation but is not a verified real-world dependence statistic.

overallWeaknesses: Comparable governance evidence is too sparse to rate political stability or institutional strength confidently.
playerAdvantages: Use targeted regional partnerships and verify country data before committing to an expensive national strategy.

strategicProfile.recommendedStrategy: Build around the strongest evidenced economic or diplomatic advantage, address the largest measured risk, and verify missing military and governance fields before major commitments.

strategyOptions.title: Improve evidence coverage before expensive commitments

peerComparison.rule: Percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year, with at least five country/territory observations in that year cohort.
peerComparison.governanceCompositeRule: The project-derived governance summary is emitted only when all six governance dimensions have available comparable peer percentiles; it is not an official governance rating.
peerComparison.interpretation: No percentile means no comparable cohort was available; it does not mean low strength.

thresholds.wgiPositiveSignal: value >= +0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale
thresholds.wgiPressureSignal: value <= -0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale
thresholds.highPublicDebtPressure: public debt >= 80% GDP in the recorded observation
thresholds.materialTradeDeficitPressure: trade balance <= -5% GDP in the recorded/derived observation
thresholds.highRelativeEconomicScale: >= 75th percentile inside an exact same-year cohort with at least five values
thresholds.highRelativeMilitarySpendingEffort: >= 75th percentile inside an exact same-year cohort; budget effort is not force strength
thresholds.countrySpecificRelationParameters: Only relation rows that differ from the known generic parameter template are treated as country-specific game-model signals

dependencies.interpretationPolicy: Only country-specific legacy parameters are presented as modelled dependencies; general macro signals are labelled as pressure signals, not proof of dependence on a named state.

peerComparison.rule: Percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year, with at least five country/territory observations in that year cohort.

Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

evidenceClasses.REGISTERED_INDICATOR: Registered source-backed or legacy value; inspect its year and source status.
evidenceClasses.REPOSITORY_DERIVED_INDEX: Project-defined index, not an official rating.
evidenceClasses.SAME_YEAR_PEER_COMPARISON: Relative comparison among values with exactly the same metric and observation year.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

dependencies.interpretationPolicy: Only country-specific legacy parameters are presented as modelled dependencies; general macro signals are labelled as pressure signals, not proof of dependence on a named state.

peerComparison.rule: Percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year, with at least five country/territory observations in that year cohort.

peerComparison.interpretation: No percentile means no comparable cohort was available; it does not mean low strength.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

limitations: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration.

dependencies.interpretationPolicy: Only country-specific legacy parameters are presented as modelled dependencies; general macro signals are labelled as pressure signals, not proof of dependence on a named state.
measurementGaps: Named import-supplier shares and critical-import concentration are not registered for every country.

overallWeaknesses: Comparable governance evidence is too sparse to rate political stability or institutional strength confidently.

strategicProfile.recommendedStrategy: Build around the strongest evidenced economic or diplomatic advantage, address the largest measured risk, and verify missing military and governance fields before major commitments.

peerComparison.rule: Percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year, with at least five country/territory observations in that year cohort.

peerComparison.interpretation: No percentile means no comparable cohort was available; it does not mean low strength.

evidenceClasses.REGISTERED_INDICATOR: Registered source-backed or legacy value; inspect its year and source status.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.

A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

peerComparison.rule: Percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year, with at least five country/territory observations in that year cohort.

thresholds.wgiPositiveSignal: value >= +0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale
thresholds.wgiPressureSignal: value <= -0.5 on the named WGI estimate scale
thresholds.highPublicDebtPressure: public debt >= 80% GDP in the recorded observation
thresholds.materialTradeDeficitPressure: trade balance <= -5% GDP in the recorded/derived observation
thresholds.highRelativeEconomicScale: >= 75th percentile inside an exact same-year cohort with at least five values
thresholds.highRelativeMilitarySpendingEffort: >= 75th percentile inside an exact same-year cohort; budget effort is not force strength
thresholds.countrySpecificRelationParameters: Only relation rows that differ from the known generic parameter template are treated as country-specific game-model signals

evidenceClasses.REGISTERED_INDICATOR: Registered source-backed or legacy value; inspect its year and source status.
evidenceClasses.REPOSITORY_DERIVED_INDEX: Project-defined index, not an official rating.
evidenceClasses.SAME_YEAR_PEER_COMPARISON: Relative comparison among values with exactly the same metric and observation year.
evidenceClasses.COUNTRY_SPECIFIC_LEGACY_GAME_PARAMETER: Country-specific OMEGA game parameter, not an observed national statistic.
evidenceClasses.GAMEPLAY_SCENARIO_REGISTRY: Simulated gameplay asset context, not an official real-world resource statistic.
evidenceClasses.DATA_GAP: Required evidence is unavailable; no low/zero value is implied.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

mandatoryCaveats: A single latest observation is a level, not proof of improvement or deterioration over time.
Missing is unknown, never zero and never automatically a strength or weakness.
Operational military capability is not rated without force, equipment, readiness and logistics evidence.
A trade deficit alone does not prove named-country dependency.
Relative percentiles are descriptive comparisons, not official rankings.

caveats: The legacy local economy and population baselines are labelled 2015 and are not independently revalidated by this profile builder.
Current external observations carry their own observation years; cross-indicator summaries can combine different years unless a same-year check is explicitly stated.
Economic influence, fiscal risk and fiscal health are repository-derived game indexes, not official rankings or ratings.
Resource-site counts and reserve values belong to the gameplay scenario registry; reserve amounts are not treated as real-world national reserves.
The diplomacy source includes generic default parameters for many countries; these are not described as country-specific behaviour.
Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
Relative percentiles compare roster entities, including territories and non-sovereign entities; they are not official international rankings.

Operational military capability is not quantified by spending, GDP or population alone.
Relative percentiles require the same metric and exact observation year; missing peer cohorts are left unranked.
A single observation is not a longitudinal progress trend.
